method: Manual whole-file reading of ten packaging/prerequisite files. Pinned bytes verified. Two XML documents parsed with stdlib ElementTree. No scripts executed.
findings: Chocolatey update validates local version/MSI inputs, computes SHA256 for x86/x64 and replaces known placeholders, rejecting unresolved known placeholders. Installer template downloads corresponding versioned GitHub assets with these hashes. Local hashes alone do not prove remotely published bytes match.

Chocolatey uninstall acts only on exactly one registry match, warns and skips multiple matches. Release script upgrades Chocolatey, accepts an API key, packs and pushes with no explicit per-step failure gates. It was read only, never run.

Prerequisites script requires administrator, modifies Visual Studio installation, installs latest package/tool dependencies and accepts WiX EULA. It changes user PATH and global extensions. These actions were not executed. Dependency selection is not a reproducible version lock.

MSI build returns success when WiX is absent, explicitly skipping MSI generation. Therefore process exit zero alone cannot qualify installer availability. Architecture loop builds arm64/x86/x64 with shared per-architecture product code for base and language transforms.
Beta build number uses git rev-list --count --all, so output depends on available repository refs/history. Production and beta use distinct upgrade-code roles and same-version policy.

Localization generator reads MSI_ keys, requires culture/LCID/codepage and XML-escapes string values. Metadata fields are inserted directly; missing metadata languages are skipped. XML parse success here covers templates, not generated Windows artifacts.

Language builds have bounded parallel jobs by default up to six, collect per-language failure results, then embed successful transforms serially. Final failures return nonzero after partial mutation of the MSI; caller must reject partial artifacts.

Temporary transform root is a fixed TEMP/WinDirStat_transforms with architecture-language children and recursive cleanup. Concurrent independent invocations can collide; no session isolation/locking observed.
COM storage embedding commits in finally, so exceptional copying can still commit a partially modified storage; no full artifact transaction established. No fault-injection or MSI API test performed.
limits: No installation, removal, elevation, prerequisite modification, downloads, package publication or external messages performed.
No Windows/WiX/Chocolatey runtime, generated MSI validation, transform fault injection or package end-to-end tests.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
